scripts.build: npm run build -w @estate/shared && npm run build -w @estate/web && npm run build -w @estate/api && npm run build -w @estate/worker
scripts.check: npm run check --workspaces --if-present && npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run beta:metrics:test && npm run testnet:web-signer:check
scripts.assets:check: node scripts/generate-presets.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-world-sprites.mjs --check && node scripts/render-preset-review.mjs --check
scripts.contract:test: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p near-estate-contract && cargo test --manifest-path contracts/estate/Cargo.toml
scripts.deploy:plan: npm run seed:check && cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p near-estate-contract && cargo run --manifest-path contracts/estate/Cargo.toml --example deploy_testnet -- --plan
scripts.deploy:seed:test: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p near-estate-contract && cargo test --manifest-path contracts/estate/Cargo.toml --example deploy_testnet
scripts.deploy:testnet: npm run seed:check && cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p near-estate-contract && cargo run --manifest-path contracts/estate/Cargo.toml --example deploy_testnet -- --apply
scripts.testnet:code:plan: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p near-estate-contract && cargo run --manifest-path contracts/estate/Cargo.toml --example upgrade_testnet -- --plan
scripts.testnet:code:upgrade: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p near-estate-contract && cargo run --manifest-path contracts/estate/Cargo.toml --example upgrade_testnet -- --apply
scripts.backup:drill: npm run build -w @estate/shared && npm run build -w @estate/api && npm run build -w @estate/worker && node scripts/state-backup-drill.mjs
scripts.indexer:load:check: npm run build -w @estate/shared && npm run build -w @estate/worker && node scripts/measure-indexer-load.mjs
scripts.indexer:api-load:check: npm run build -w @estate/shared && npm run build -w @estate/api && npm run build -w @estate/worker && node scripts/measure-indexer-api-load.mjs
scripts.testnet:journey: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p near-estate-contract && cargo run --manifest-path contracts/estate/Cargo.toml --example testnet_journey -- --apply
scripts.testnet:web-signer:check: tsc --noEmit --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --target es2022 --types vite/client,node --resolveJsonModule --allowSyntheticDefaultImports --skipLibCheck --strict scripts/testnet-web-signer-journey.ts
scripts.testnet:inspector-journey: npm run build -w @estate/api && cargo run --manifest-path contracts/estate/Cargo.toml --example testnet_inspector_journey -- --apply
scripts.testnet:moderation-journey: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p near-estate-contract && cargo run --manifest-path contracts/estate/Cargo.toml --example testnet_moderation_journey -- --apply
scripts.testnet:event-source: cargo run --manifest-path contracts/estate/Cargo.toml --example event_source_probe -- --apply && npm run build -w @estate/shared && node scripts/verify-event-source.mjs
